system.notes:
Fungibolds are deep-dwelling kobolds who have become one with the cave mushrooms, forming a hive mind. Their magi leaders become anchored to the earth as they merge with the vast network of underground fungi roots. A pale, fat mushroom of waist-height with a scintillating cap of flowing colors. A smooth, lizard-like face is carved into the flesh of the stem. A knowing intelligence winks in its black, glittering eyes.

AC 6, HP 30, ATK 2 mind melt (far) +4 (2d6) or 1 spell +4 or 1 spore blast, MV none, S -4, D -4, C +3, I +1, W +3, Ch +3, AL N, LV 6

Hive Mind. Can telepathically speak with other fungibolds within a mile.

Spore Blast. Enemies in near DC 12 CON or fall asleep 1d4 rounds. Creatures who pass immune 1 day.

Confusion (WIS Spell). DC 13. Far, one target. DC 15 WIS or target can’t take actions and moves in a random direction on its turn for 1d4 rounds.

Mind Meld (WIS Spell). DC 11. Near, one target creature. DC 12 WIS or target connected to Hive Mind as if it were a fungibold. Lasts 1 day.

Poison Spores (WIS Spell). DC 12. All non-fungibolds in near DC 12 CON or take 1d6 damage per round (cumulative if from multiple spells). DC 12 CON on turn to end all effects.

Art by Jessee Egan, 2023
